'''Bowdaar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] forced by his masters into becoming a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] fighter in arenas spanning [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. His prowess as a warrior and undefeated record earned him the names "'''The Killer from Kashyyyk'''," "'''Deathmountain'''," and "'''Boneshatterer'''."

==Biography==
Captured as a child from his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], Bowdaar was forced into a life of violence, fighting for survival in gladiator arenas from one side of the galaxy to the other. He proved himself to be a very capable fighter. Over more than a century, Bowdaar fought in single combat in more than ten thousand matches against such formidable opponents as [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]], [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]] and even a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. In all that time he never lost a match.<ref name="Holonet" />

Almost more impressive was the fact that Bowdaar often fought without a single weapon or piece of armor. Amongst the more ignorant and gullible denizens of the criminal underworld, rumors spread that he was some form of immortal being. Those who faced Bowdaar in combat and lived to tell about it said he was simply the best fighter around.<ref name="Holonet" />

By [[3643 BBY]], Bowdaar ended up a pet gladiator to [[Drooga]] the Hutt to pay off a gambler's debt. He kept Bowdaar in a cage between matches and used him cruelly and pettily. Drooga was annoyed that Bowdaar slew all his opponents too quickly, depriving him of the full entertainment value of the fights. He took many steps to keep Bowdaar at a disadvantage, such as depriving him of any weapons and draining half his blood to keep him weak, and even poisoning him outright.

It was at this time when a [[Voidhound|smuggler captain]] arrived on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to barter a male [[shanjaru]] for a prototype engine. Upon locating Drooga's barge in the Nikto Sector, Bowdaar was to fight a gang of [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] warriors. Though the Wookiee could've taken them by himself, the smuggler chose to intervene. Bowdaar later assisted the smuggler against [[Zank Helrott]], [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher's]] bounty hunter.

Finally, Drooga decided to do away with the Wookiee in one last magnificent fight to the death with his pet gundark, which he had kept starving for the occasion. The smuggler captain assisted Bowdaar in his fight with the gundark, which simultaneously infuriated Drooga while also providing him with suitable entertainment for the evening. Once the gundark was dead, Drooga decided that the Wookiee was no longer worth the costs to maintain him and simply turned him loose, who then joined the smuggler's crew.

==Personality and traits==
Bowdaar was a loner and having grown up as a slave owned by one master or another for decades, considered himself to have no home, family or friends. His success in the fighting pits earned his various masters untold wealth, but he never shared in the spoils of his victories. What he did own was the heart and strength of a warrior and an unparalleled will to survive.<ref name="Holonet" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I have hung a broken chain from a sprig of wroshyr each Life Day to honor you.|Bowdaar, upon reuniting with the Smuggler|<ref name="Freedom Fight" />}}
[[File:Bowdaar.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Bowdaar Gear concept art]]
Bowdaar was first mentioned in a [[The Holonet]] entry on the official ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' website. His entry has several phrases written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] which read "Good luck redhead," "[[Karssk]]'s Prey" and "Great Feastmaster's collateral."<ref name="Holonet" />

Bowdaar becomes the second companion for the Smuggler character in ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'', following the completion of the storyline on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

Bowdaar appears again in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as an Alliance quest when the player has to participate in the [[Arena Grand|Zakuulan arena]] in order to recruit him as a companion.<ref name="Freedom Fight" />
